reason: H0 only calls plist_from_bin or plist_from_xml and then plist_free; it never traverses parsed nodes or invokes the new borrowed-buffer getter APIs. Consequently, fuzz-derived PLIST_STRING and PLIST_DATA states do not exercise their type checks, length reporting, optional-versus-required length-pointer behavior, or returned internal-buffer semantics.
evidence: plist_get_string_ptr returns NULL for a NULL or non-PLIST_STRING node, permits length == NULL, otherwise writes data->length, and returns data->strval.
plist_get_data_ptr returns NULL when node or length is NULL or when the node is not PLIST_DATA; otherwise it writes data->length and returns data->buff.
The declarations state that both returned buffers are borrowed, must not be modified, and remain available only until the plist node is freed.
fuzz/bplist_fuzzer.cc and fuzz/xplist_fuzzer.cc perform only parsing followed by plist_free(root_node); neither calls plist_get_string_ptr or plist_get_data_ptr.
recommended_action: Extend a harness to recursively visit fuzz-parsed nodes before plist_free, call plist_get_string_ptr on PLIST_STRING nodes with both non-NULL and NULL length arguments, and call plist_get_data_ptr on PLIST_DATA nodes with a valid length argument. Exercise NULL and wrong-type nodes and check returned pointers, reported lengths, and content against the corresponding copying getters without dereferencing borrowed pointers after plist_free.
